title: Beginning a Game
intro: Opening stones leave room for later play. A finished wall and a first move have different jobs.

steps.instruction: Compare C9 on the edge with C7. Which leaves room toward both nearby edges?
steps.explanation: Your stone leaves room toward two edges. White takes the middle. You have a starting area, not territory that is already yours.
steps.hint: C7 leaves space above and to the left. Try that starting point.

steps.instruction: White has approached. Extend beside your stone, keeping its liberties.
steps.explanation: Your stones share liberties and leave room nearby. You do not need to draw a complete wall now. Check nearby threats before continuing your plan.

outro: Use Help during practice to inspect captures or groups with one liberty.
